question: Can numerical weight edits without gradients or provided novel-family primitives infer truly held-out compositional causal operators from equal action-consequence evidence, retain old rules, and outperform both exact symbolic and fully fitted conventional controls?
candidate: Direct 64-dimensional GF(2) numerical ANF weight vector. From own 32 observed public interventions, start all weights=0. At each of at most 16 deterministic iterations, evaluate every monomial's action signature, select bit-toggle with largest strict reduction in residual Hamming error, break ties by smaller degree then mask integer; flip exactly one coefficient. No source-label, future query, transfer family or prior evaluation input. If residual >0 at finish abstain on all 64 predictions. Otherwise predict XOR of active numerical coefficients for all x. Source-blind independent generic feature basis includes all 64 possible monomials (including constant); does NOT include MAJ, MUX, or selector-specific primitives.

source.kind: Fresh public synthetic, not original native/real-world first-use
source.compositional: 291000..291007 (8); permuted 3-factor AND XOR 2-factor AND XOR singleton
source.unseen_majority: 292000..292031 (32); permuted FIVE-variable threshold >=3 XOR sixth variable XOR constant. The threshold operator is NOT present in the candidate or the prior WSP143 four-term rule basis.
source.unseen_mux: 293000..293007 (8); selector bit chooses XOR of 3 bits vs AND of remaining 2, with possible seed XOR constant
source.unstructured: 294000..294007 (8); seeded independent Bernoulli truth table, structured negative control
source.cold: 295000..295007 (8); 0-effect queries, exact relabels of familiar laws
reserved_and_denied: all historically scored WSP135..146 cohorts and original protected CausalGym/DTR/MDP
source.law: Hidden seeded role permutation, family and output truth held by source-owning evaluator only

acquisition.warm: same ordered 20 action coordinates across all arms
acquisition.forbidden: Policies receive no future queries, family name, private truth/roles or other-arm effects
acquisition.hidden: After all three arms seal 64 predictions for every method, owner selects 8 common NEVER-paid coordinates, using WSP147|HELD|law_id|x, without labels. All arms share same 8. A world is the unit of replication. These are unseen query coordinates within law, NOT novel-world holdout after training.
acquisition.sequential_transfer: All familiar/compositional worlds processed before novel families only for retention audit; candidate is fit independently per law, not a persistent meta-learner. NO claims of learning transfer across worlds based solely on novelty of test family.

comparators.original_hierarchical: EXACT WSP143 H.fit/predict on own 32 rows, 4-term native-style basis (without special novel operators)
comparators.independent_symbolic: EXACT WSP143 flat_control independent equal-prior symbolic, must tie H on every x
comparators.fully_fitted_cart: EXACT WSP135 fully trained CART on same 32 observed outcomes, no structure/extra labels
comparators.original_direct_three_term: EXACT WSP142 direct weights on same rows
comparators.full_polynomial_symbolic: independent general 64-feature GF2 row-reduction minimum pivot solution, descriptive reference only, same rows; cannot claim candidate superiority solely over insufficient WSP143 capacity.
comparators.negative: OFF/independent random truth table; refuse confident false causal claims
comparators.oracle: Privately generated source-family oracle scores, no oracle fit to the candidate

metrics.primary: Unseen FIVE threshold family: 32 independent worlds x 8 shared post-seal never-paid query coordinates=256. Report correct, wrong-confident, abstained, per-world paired gains, 95% world-bootstrap CI (fixed resample seed) and exact source receipts.
metrics.whole_process_cost: Record total wall/CPU, per-policy acquisition+train+64 readout, candidate fit/edit count, peak allocations. Claimed acceleration requires separately measured end-to-end matched wall and CPU, not timed partial stages.

boundaries.code_first: Sole-file prereg committed before new source, source effects, implementation, or novel-family learning
boundaries.source_safe_implementation: Isolated WSP147 files only + project-local workflow; compare old frozen source/result/prereg files exactly
boundaries.os: Linux+Windows original source-safe prospective study; freeze authentic first result, including negative
boundaries.final: Source-pin G29 derived-only atlas, exact SHA Linux/Windows inherited WSP135-147 plus complete root regression, independent G29
boundaries.limitation: Synthetic predeclared family does not test real-world grounding, semantic general intelligence, native Yggdrasil model integration or learned cross-world transfer. True grammar unfamiliarity is relative to solver primitive library, not to researcher who authored source.
